fields.title: Shokan: Watanabe Shizuko kara Shū Chōkan e no Igi Shō

letter.message: Watashi no sen'i shōgyō kyoka no kyūteki torikeshi to kōshō hiyō no fuka ni kan shi, saikō o yōsei itashimasu. Seikatsu to shōbai no kiki de arimasu.

context.purpose: Shōgyō kyoka torikeshi ni taisuru igi mōshitate.

claims.fact: Kojin shokan wa shinseisha ga kyoka torikeshi ni taisuru fufuku o chokusetsu utatta koto o shōmei suru.
